seo.title: Jagadish: The Hindu Lord of the Universe
seo.meta_description: Discover the meaning, origins, and significance of the Hindu name Jagadish, the name of Lord Vishnu who is believed to rule and protect the universe.
seo.description_paragraph: Jagadish is a powerful and spiritual name rooted in Hinduism. The name Jagadish is derived from Sanskrit and is composed of two words - jagat and ish. Jagat means the universe and ish means god or ruler. Thus, Jagadish means the lord of the universe. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe in Hindu mythology. Jagadish is a name that evokes a sense of spirituality, power, and protection.
